rows.proof: PARITY_PROVEN: 526 donor mentions from 240 frozen captured bodies match on canonical URL, author, score, text and published time
divergences: harken drops items without the keyword (236); ECDEV keeps every returned item as an observation of the query
harken stamps the current time when a timestamp is missing (63); ECDEV keeps it UNKNOWN
harken prefers Bluesky indexedAt (185); ECDEV keeps the author's createdAt
harken identifies Bluesky authors by handle; ECDEV by DID, with the handle in the URL

rows.note: the native rule had no production caller until the two trend-watch triggers were added
ECDEV reads JSON Feed natively and reports XML RSS as explicitly unsupported
ECDEV acquires only Hacker News, Bluesky and JSON Feed; the others need keys, OAuth or scraping ECDEV does not do
ECDEV snapshots disclose their actual capture and publication windows and persist in its own store
ECDEV acquisition runs keep partial source failures visible and suppress disappearance alerts; the donor pipeline is not reproduced
ECDEV keeps a disclosed minimal sentiment rule and its own term clusters; a larger uncalibrated lexicon would add apparent precision without evidence
LLM labels are not evidence; zero-paid default
